guidance: Feature ONE specific free tool actually published at blackarrow.ltd/tools (a calculator, an audit, an AI builder, or Black Arrow OS — the free pocket CRM). Everything on that page is free value used as a lead magnet. Lead with what the tool tells or gives the owner, cite its stated value where the site shows one, and end with the TOOLS keyword CTA. evidence_note: Only describe tools/offers actually published on the Black Arrow site.

guidance: Use a credible external study to explain why a capability matters. Qualified language: 'Research suggests...', 'The study found...'.
evidence_note: Attribute the source. NEVER imply Black Arrow produced the result or achieves the same without evidence.
reason: Balancing the mix: 'Third-Party Research / Market Evidence' was the most under-served eligible category (target 7%, recent 3%).
post_rationale: Fills the Research/Authority slot with a defensible pattern claim about written SLAs versus informal practice, avoiding fabricated study specifics while keeping the knowing-doing gap tension and a concrete 3-step action, closing to the free Lead Response Audit.

guidance: Promote the Black Arrow platform (blackarrow.ltd/app) through its real offers: the 14-day full-access free trial (no card needed, cancel anytime) and the referral deal (refer a business, when they subscribe you both get a free month, tracked automatically). reason: Balancing the mix: 'Platform / Free Trial Promo' was the most under-served eligible category (target 12%, recent 10%).
